  "description": "The Job holder plays a role to support application/system, focusing on Core system for daily operation. Candidate is responsible for analyzing the business requirements, understanding IT systems/applications and communicating with internal/external stakeholder to ensure the smooth application/system operation. The job holder also ensures that the application/system issues can be solved on time.\n\n* In charge of analyzing and preparing business and system requirements for the IT Lending Core systems\n* Ensure proper due diligence and gap analysis is done for application implementation against the business requirements\n* Work cohesively with the application vendor’s application supporters to get the required knowledge transfer for the product knowledge and business process.\n* Providing system/application support for end user and know-how supports to internal teams.\n* Managing and leveraging between end user’s expectation and the base lined business requirements\n* Supporting User Acceptance Test for the project sign off.\n* Project-management to implement of Lending Core system enhancement.\n* Work with external vendor to follow up core system issues/enhancement.\n* Configure the core system business rules for setup new products in core.\n* Develop Core system APIs and other customization to fit to business needs.\n* Support Core system operation (co-work with ICT operation team and ICT development team)\n* Other tasks assigned by line manager, division head.",
  "requirements_text": "Tổng quan\nYêu cầu:\n5 năm kinh nghiệm chuyên môn  5 năm kinh nghiệm quản lý  Đại Học trở lên\nChuyên môn:\nChuyên môn Công nghệ thông tin khác  Ngân hàng  Chứng khoán  Tài chính\n\nYêu cầu ứng viên\n1. Qualification\n* University Degree majored in Information Technology\n\n2. Work Experience\n* Minimum 05 years working experience in Software development and Application support.\n* Have experience on business analysis and system analysis.\n* Have experience on core banking, core securities or core lending system.\n* Have experience in project management for projects related to core system/product development\n* Have working experience in Finance/Banking/Insurance/Securities is a plus.\n\n3. Knowledge\n* Providing system/application support for end user and know-how supports to internal teams.\n* Work with external vendor to follow up core system issues/enhancement.\n* Experience on both Java, PL/SQL development\n* Good experience on API development and system integration.\n* Have knowledge on ITIL framework and process\n\n4. Skills\n* Good leadership skill for effective Team management\n* Communication\n* Problem-solving\n* Effective application support\n* Good collaboration\n* Critical thinking\n* Can-do attitude\n* Time management\n\nKiến thức ngành\nNgân hàng, Chứng khoán, Tài chính\n\nKỹ năng cần có\nProject Management, application support, Core Card, Core lending, System analysis"
